exposure: Follow-up assessment for pediatric traumatic injury (PTI) patients and caregivers
outcome: Proportion of centers providing behavioral health screening
Identified barriers to service implementation (lack of staff, time, funding)
Identified facilitators to service implementation (enthusiasm, perceived feasibility of technology-enhanced, stepped-care approaches)
cohort: The study surveyed 83 Level I and Level II Pediatric Trauma Center (PTC) program managers and coordinators across 36 states, and conducted qualitative interviews with 24 of these participants.
finding: Roughly half of the surveyed pediatric trauma centers provide behavioral health screening, and while centers are enthusiastic about implementing services, they report significant barriers including a need for training and a lack of staff, time, and funding.
cross-section timing: Information on current behavioral health resources and implementation barriers/facilitators was collected via survey and interviews at a single point in time.
